activeQuestion.prompt: An employee misses Friday’s deadline. What can they still plan to see?
activeQuestion.promptZh: 一位員工錯過週五截止時間，還能安排去看什麼？

options.text: Reserved seating at the civic center without contacting anyone.
options.zh: 不必聯絡任何人就能在市民中心取得預留席位。
options.whyZh: 出席需在期限前聯絡，且席位有限。

options.text: A school demonstration scheduled by the council on June twelfth.
options.zh: 協會安排在六月十二日舉辦的學校示範活動。
options.whyZh: 六月十二日是頒獎，沒有宣布那天辦示範。

options.text: Photographs from the volunteer program in reception next month.
options.zh: 下個月在接待區看到志工計畫的照片。
options.whyZh: 照片展是另一項安排，不依賴頒獎席位。

options.text: A live ceremony shown at the staff reception desk.
options.zh: 在員工接待處收看頒獎直播。
options.whyZh: 接待區展示的是照片，不是頒獎直播。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 週五是聯絡主講者申請出席的期限；接待區下月另有照片展，不需取得六個頒獎席位之一。
activeQuestion.evidence: Contact speaker by Friday for ceremony; program photographs displayed in reception next month.

vocabulary.note: 親自操作而不只是聽講。
本公告指參與過校訪的員工優先獲得席位。
指展示計畫照片的位置，不是典禮場地。

originalQuestion.prompt: What should interested employees do by Friday?
originalQuestion.promptZh: 有興趣的員工最遲應在星期五做什麼？

options.whyZh: 照片下月展示，但沒有星期五交圖要求。

options.text: Tell the speaker they want to attend
options.zh: 向講者表明自己有意出席
options.whyZh: 有意出席的員工應最遲於星期五聯絡講者。
電子學是校園活動內容，非員工報名條件。

group.title: An award announcement
group.passage: F1: Our company won the council's community partnership award. It honors our technicians' volunteer repair sessions at schools, not our sales. Schools wrote to the council about how hands-on activities helped students understand electronics. The ceremony is at the civic center on June twelfth. We have six seats. Employees who joined a school visit get priority. Contact me by Friday if you want a seat. Next month we'll display photos from the program in reception.
group.passageZh: 本公司獲得協會的社區合作獎。獎項表揚的是公司技師在學校辦的志工維修活動，而不是銷售表現。學校寫信給協會，說明動手實作如何幫助學生理解電子學。頒獎典禮在六月十二日於市民中心舉行，公司有六個席位。參與過校訪的員工優先。如需席位，請在週五前聯絡我。下個月會在接待區展示計畫照片。
